videos.description: New post! GUMI look only greatttttGUMI is a virtual character associated with the Megpoid voice synthesis software, developed by Internet Co., Ltd. Her voice is based on the singer and voice actress Megumi Nakajima, from whom the name "GUMI" is derived, a nickname created by Megumi. GUMI is known for her short green hair and her characteristic orange aviator sunglasses perched on her head. Her personality is usually portrayed as cheerful, energetic, friendly, and somewhat mischievous, although, like other voice synthesizer characters, her personality can vary depending on the song or the fans' interpretation. Her first appearance was in 2009 with the release of Megpoid for the Vocaloid engine. Thanks to the naturalness and expressiveness of her voice, she quickly became one of the most popular virtual voices in Japan. She is especially recognized for adapting to many musical genres, from pop and rock to more emotional or intense songs. Among the most famous songs she's featured on are Matryoshka, Panda Hero, Echo, and Coward Montblanc. These songs helped solidify her status as one of the most recognized virtual voices within the Vocaloid community. Unlike characters such as Hatsune Miku, GUMI doesn't belong to Crypton Future Media, but rather to Internet Co., Ltd. Even so, she is considered one of the most important and beloved virtual vocalists in Vocaloid history.  #VOCALOID #GUMI #fyp #xybzca #foryoupage
